final: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS rental_total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), store_averages AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(rental_total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id), kept AS (SELECT rt.store_id, rt.rental_total, sa.avg_total FROM rental_totals rt JOIN store_averages sa ON rt.store_id = sa.store_id WHERE rt.rental_total > sa.avg_total) SELECT store_id, SUM(rental_total) AS total_kept_rental_totals, AVG(rental_total - avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_store_average FROM kept GROUP BY store_id
